retired: a method of the `nros::LifecycleNode` mixin, now `nros::detail::LifecycleEngine` (phase-482 W4). `rclcpp_lifecycle::LifecycleNode` binds, registers its services and manages its publishers itself
why: two-phase construction for the component model: a nano-ros component is constructed before the executor handle exists (RFC-0043/0044 -- components are declared and installed, not constructed with their dependencies), so a component that inherits `LifecycleNode` default-constructs and binds the handle from its install hook. rclcpp has no equivalent because its node is constructed with everything it needs.
